Road conditions

  • (404)624-7700 Road conditions
  • 511ga.org
  • https://dps.georgia.gov/road-conditions

When a Permit is needed

  • Over 8’6” wide
  • Over 13’6” high
  • Over 100’ long
  • Over 80,000 gross weight

Special Information Needed

  • Insurance company: name, policy number, expiration date
  • IFTA # if you have one

Times of Movement

  • 1/2 hour after sunrise to 1/2 hour before sunset; Monday-Saturday

No Sunday travel

  • Permitted loads in excess of 12’ wide - No Travel when visibility is less than 600’ or windspeed is greater than 25 mph
  • Prohibited holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, & Christmas
  • No travel into/through Atlanta area bounded by I-285 unless picking up or delivering in the city. Curfews: 7-9am & 4-6pm; M-F

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • 2-lane/2-way traffic highways:
  • 1 front when over 12’ wide
  • 14’6”-16’ -1 front/1 rear
  • Multi-lane highways:
  • 1 rear/amber light if over 12’ wide
  • 1 rear 14’6”-16’
  • All roads & highways:
  • Over 16’ wide 1 front/1 rear
  • 1 rear/amber light when over 75' long.
  • 1 rear when 100’-125’
  • 2 (front & rear) when over 125'
  • 1 front w/height pole when over 15'6" high.
  • *15’+ high requires a front escort w/ height sensor when traveling through larger cities where traffic signals may be encountered.

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • General: Must be a pickup or an automobile
  • Signs: Mounted on front of front escort/on back of rear escort. Size: 6’ x 1’; black letters 8” x 4” (min.) on orange or federal yellow background saying “OVERSIZE LOAD”
  • Lights: Amber light or strobe light (8” in diameter min.) located on top of vehicle w/ candlepower of 35,000 (min.) and 80 revolutions/min. or equivalent 4” strobe light visible at least ¼ mile
  • *Need a permit from DPS, PO Box 101072, Atlanta, GA 30392; (678)413-8786 (fee: $2.00/year)
  • Amber Light Permit Application
  • Flags: Color-Red; Size-18” square; Mounting locations-Top of vehicle 45 degree angle, not extending more than 6” beyond vehicle.
  • Additional equipment:
  • 1. 2-way radio;
  • 2. Outside rear-view mirrors, located on each side of the vehicle
  • 3. Stop/Slow Paddle: the sign shall be at least 18”x 18” ( or a 24”x 24” sign or high-intensity flashing stop/slow paddle) with 6 inch high letters, octagonal, and should be mounted on a rigid handle. Must be reflective for night moves;
  • 4. Safety Helmet
  • 5. Vest or high visibility clothing-orange, yellow, yellow green or fluorescent versions of these colors.
  • 6. 9 (at least) bi-directional retroreflective triangles-minimum 17”arm length & minimum arm width of 2”.
  • 7. 8 red-burning flares, glow sticks or equivalent illumination device.
  • 8. 3 orange cones-18” high
  • 9. 1 fire extinguisher-5 lb. Min-Type “BC” or “ABC”
  • 10. Traffic wand flashlight w/ safety nose cone + spare batteries
  • 11. 1st Aid Kit-clearly marked
  • 12. Serviceable spare tire
  • 13. Escort vehicle id sign-minimum 8” x 12”-displayed on each side of vehicle (name, city & state of company/owner of vehicle)
  • 14. 2 (min.) Red flags mounted to the top of vehicle
  • http://www.dot.ga.gov/PartnerSmart/permits/Documents/StudentWorkbook.pdf

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • Escort vehicle operators will be required to obtain an approved certification prior to performing duties of an escort vehicle. Must complete a defensive driving course approved by the national safety council, or an equivalent course.
